held.title: The usage insert takes the student only from the assessment instance, which can break group-assessment submissions.
held.body:
The recorder gets only `assessment_instance_id`. It never receives the submitting `user_id`, so `insert_shared_question_usages` must work out the student from the assessment instance. On group (team) assessments, `assessment_instances.user_id` is NULL and the instance belongs to a team. If the SQL selects `ai.user_id` without expanding team members or skipping NULLs, the insert into `destination_user_id bigint not null` throws. This runs inside the `insertSubmission` transaction, so every saved answer to a copied question on a group assessment would be rolled back and fail. I could not see `shared-question-usages.sql`, so I could not confirm this.

Fix: pass the submission's `user_id`, or make the SQL resolve team members and skip rows with no user. Also add a test for a group assessment.
